response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship and polyglot programming skills, but his background shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, A/B testing infrastructure, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics systems, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His title trajectory (Senior/Staff, not clearly IC6/Principal scope) and lack of large-scale distributed systems ownership or cross-team platform leadership further misalign with the job's requirements.
strengths: 18+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring, workshops, open-source platform ownership (GISCollective)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) and polyglot proficiency including required languages (Java, C, C++, C#, JS/TS)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation/A-B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management
No evidence of telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or data-driven growth systems work
Career history shows lateral moves across small/mid-size companies without clear principal-level, multi-team platform ownership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering breadth and language proficiency
